name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
label: Quest
description: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The highborne spirits are miserable creatures, that's for sure. They are still searching for pieces of the very thing that has cursed them to Kel'Theril forever -- the stolen relic.
If you are that interested, take my pick and go south to the lake, see if you can gather the pieces of it from within the ice.
Now, I can't tell you a thing about what you find, but I do know of someone who might... Aurora Skycaller; she dwells near the Northpass Tower in the northern part of Eastern Plaguelands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The past of the high elves is something that I do not wish to discuss, friend. Please, it pains me to think of all that has happened... And that there is no way to make things right.
